verses.text:
Nnaawɔtwe da a ɛdi kan no m’
Yɛn Agyenkwa sɔre firii nna mu
Owuiɛ, wɔsiee no, wasɔre
Sɛ ɔnni hene na ɔnnye yɛn nkwa.

Nnaawɔtwe da a ɛdi kan no m’
Asuafoɔ hyia bubu aboodoo
Wɔnom nkaeɛ kuruwa ano
De kae deɛ ɔkyii ne mogya mmaeɛ.

Nnaawɔtwe da a ɛdi kan no m’
Momma yɛnsiesie yɛn ho nsie
Na yɛmfa deɛ Ahene mu Hene
De adom yɛn no mu bi mmerɛ no.

Saa da yi mu na Yohane
Hunuu Kristo na ɔtee ne nne
Yɛ‘ nso yɛsom wɔ honhom mu
De mpaeɛ ne nnwom ma yɛn ani gye.

1.chorus:
Sɛ binom bɛpo Awurade a
Yɛn deɛ yɛpɛ wo nokware no
Woka yɛn ho kyekyere yɛn werɛ
Nnaawɔtwe da a ɛdi kan no m’.

verses.text:
Me kra awia, m’agyenkwa pa
Wobɛn me a adeɛ nsa me da
Mma sum bi mfiri asase yi so
Nhinta wo mfiri w’akoa ani so.

Sɛ ɛnna de ne bosuo no
Ka m’ani brɛfoɔ yi gu so a
Ma mennwene dɛ a ɛbɛyɛ
Sɛ mɛhome m’agyenkwa bo m’ daa.

Wo ne me ntena adekyeeɛ mu
Wonni me nkyɛn a mentumi ntena ase
Adeɛ resa a wo ne me ntena
Woka me ho a mensuro wuo.

Sɛ yɛnyane a bɛhyira yɛn
Ansa na yɛafa yɛn akwan so
Kɔsi sɛ ɔdɔ kɛseɛ no
De yɛn bɛpue ɔsoro nohoaa.

Nhyira nka ‘homa a ɛka
Yɛn akoma bom Kristo dɔm
Ayɔnkofa wɔ adwene korɔ m’
Te sɛ ɔsoro deɛ no.

Yɛhwie yɛn mpaeɛ denden
Gu Agya ahennwa no anim
Yɛn suro, yɛn botaeɛ yɛ koro
Yɛn awerekyekyerɛ ne yɛn hia.

Yɛkyɛ yɛn amaneɛ koro
Yɛsoa yɛn adesoa koro no
Na yɛtaa nya ayamhyehyeɛ
Ma yɛn nuanom nyinaa.

Sɛ yɛn mu hwete a
Yɛdi yea wɔ yɛn mu pii
Nanso yɛbom wɔ akoma mu
Na yɛnim sɛ yɛbɛhyia bio

Mo a modɔ Awurade
Mommra, momma mo ani nnye
Monsɔ mu nto nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ
Monsɔ mu nto nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ
Montwa ahennwa n’ho nhyia.

Wɔn a wɔnnim Nyame
Wɔrento nnwom yi bi
Na ɔsoro Hene no mma no deɛ
Na ɔsoro Hene no mma no deɛ
Wɔbɛka wɔn anigyeɛ akyerɛ aman
Wɔbɛka akyerɛ aman.

Zion kokoɔ kronkron no
Ɛso nnepa mpempem
Sɛ yɛduru soro asase so
Sɛ yɛduru soro asase so
Anaa sika mmorɔno no so
Sika mmorɔno no so.

Momma nnwom no nkɔ so
Na nisuo nyinaa nwe
Yɛnam Emmanuel asase so
Yɛnam Emmanuel asase so
Akɔ bea fɛɛfɛ bi wɔ soro
Bea fɛɛfɛ bi wɔ soro.

4.chorus:
Yɛretu sa akɔ Zion
Zion fɛɛfɛ no
Yɛretu sa akɔ Zion
Nyame kuro fɛɛfɛ.

verses.text:
Ɔdɔ kronkron ɛkyɛn ‘dɔ biara
Soro anigyeɛ aba fam ha
Fa yɛn mu yɛ wo tenabea
Ma w’ahummɔborɔ nni mu
Yesu woyɛ awerɛkyekyerɛ
Woyɛ ‘dɔ a ɛnni ano
Fa wo nkwagyeɛ bɛsra yɛn
Bɛwura akoma biara mu.

Akoma biara a abrɛ no
Home wo dɔ honhom gu mu
Ma yɛnnya adedie wo mu
Ne ahomegyeɛ a woahyɛ ho bɔ no
Yi bɔne ho dɔ firi yɛn mu
Ne yɛn afɔdie adesoa no
Wie adwuma a woahyɛ aseɛ no
Fa yɛn kɔ daa nkwa no mu.

Tumfoɔ Agya bra bɛgye yɛn
Ma yɛn nsa nka wo nkwa no
San bra na bɛtena yɛn mu
Nnya wo ntomadan yi bio
Wo na yɛbɛhyira wo daa daa
Na yɛasom wo sɛ soro dɔm no
Yɛde mpaebɔ ne ayeyie a
Ɛntwa da atena wo dɔ mu.

Afei wie w’abɔdeɛ foforɔ
Te yɛn ho firi nkekaeɛ nyinaa ho
Ma yɛnhunu nkwagyeɛ kɛseɛ a
Woanya ama yɛn no
Sesa yɛn kɔ w’anuonyam mu
Ma soro nyɛ yɛn tenabea
Ma yɛnto yɛn adeɛ ngu w’anim
Wo dɔ ne ayeyie mu.

Brɛbrɛ na ɛyɛ Okristoni
Fa ntoaboaseɛ yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa
Nyame na ɔse brɛbrɛ na ɛyɛ
Okristoni ee, brɛbrɛ na ɛyɛ

Mma wo bo mfu Okristoni
Fa notoabaseɛ yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa
Nyame na ɔse mma wo bo mfu
Okristoni ee, mma wo bo mfu.

Kae mmara nsɛm no, Okristoni
Na bɔ mmɔden di so daa nyinaa
Nyame na ɔse Okristoni ee
Sɛ wodɔ me a, di me mmara so.

Gyae nkɔkɔnsa na ka nokorɛ
Gyae nsekubɔ, gyae akayɔ
Nyame na ɔse gyae nkɔnkɔnsa
Okristoni ee, gyae nkɔnkɔnsa.

Ma w’ani so na hwɛ soro hɔ
Na kae hunu sɛ Onyame nnaeɛ
Bɔne a yɛyɛ, ohunu ne nyinaa
Okristoni ee, di asɛmpa.

Ɛnna rekɔ ɛnna reba

Ɔsoro hɔ wowɔ akonta bi bu
Okristoni ee, ɔbra twa owuo

Sɛ Agyenkwa no frɛ a mɛgye so
Sɛ ɔfrɛ me a mɛte ne nne
Sɛ Agyenka no frɛ a mɛgye so
Mɛgyina baabi na matie me din.

Sɛ m’akoma tene na ɔfrɛ me
Sɛ m’akoma tene a mɛte ne nne
Sɛ m’akoma tene na ɔfrɛ me
Mɛgyina baabi na matie me din.

Sɛ m’atadeɛ hyerɛn na ɔfrɛ me

Sɛ m’atadeɛ hyerɛn na ɔfrɛ me

Mɛgyina baabi matie
Mɛgyina baabi matie
Mɛgyina baabi na matie me din.

verses.text:
O ka asɛmpa no
Baabiara a nnipa teɛ
Baabiara nnipa ho asɛm
Ne amaneɛ wɔ
Ma Kristoni biara nka anigyeɛ nsɛm yi
Yɛn Wura, yɛn awura mu Wura.

Monhwɛ ahene mu Hene

Brɛ akra a wɔayera
Ma nkonim nnwom no
Nnyegye ebunu no mu

8.chorus:

Asɛm Kronkron a ɛte aseɛ
Ne din yɛ dɛ kyɛn so
Ne pɛ ma nkwagyeɛ
O ka asɛmpa no
Baabiara a nnipa teɛ
Yɛn Wura, yɛn ahene mu Hene.

verses.text:
Sɔhwɛ ne haw taa gya yɛn adwendwene sɛ
Adɛn na ɛwɔ sɛ ɛba saa mmerɛ nyinaa
Berɛ a ɛbinom atwa yɛn ho ahyia
Wɔyɛ bɔne nso haw nni wɔn so.

Sɛ owuo ba bɛfa yɛn adɔfo kɔ
Ɛgya awerɛhoɔ ne suro yɛn afie mu
Na ɛma yɛdwene wɔn a asi wɔn yie ho
Sɛ wɔte bɔne mu mmerɛ nyinaa.

Yɛn wura no se di nokware kɔ owuo mu
Yɛ adwuma twɛn nna kakra yi mu
Na yɛremmu ɔkwan mu suro no
Sɛ yɛhyɛn ɔpon fɛɛfɛ no mu a.

Sɛ yɛhunu Yesu sɛ ɔba n’anuonyam
Sɛ ɔfiri ne soro fie no mu ba a
Yɛbɛhyia no wɔ fie hyɛnhyɛn no mu
Ɛnkyɛ bi yɛbɛte ne nyinaa ase.

9.chorus:
Anim hɔ yɛbɛhunu biribiara
Anim hɔ yɛbɛte ne nyinaa ase
Ma w’ani nnye me nua, ka wo ho hye
Ɛnkyɛ bi yɛbɛte ne nyinaa ase.

verses.text:
Mɛdu nnepa asase so
Ɛhɔ adeɛ nyinaa bɛyɛ me deɛ
Na ɛhɔ deɛ ade nsa da
Na me sum nyinaa bɛtwam akɔ.

Agyenkwa no ne me nante
Yɛnya ayɔnkofa dɛɛdɛ ha
Ɔsɔ me nsa na ɔdi m’anim
Ɛfiri sɛ ha yɛ soro hyeɛ so

Duhwam bi wɔ mframa no mu
Ɛfiri nnua a ɛte aseɛ daa so
Nhwiren a wɔn ɔhoɔfɛ mpa da
Ne nkwa nsuo sen daa nyinaa.

Nnwontoɔ dɛɛdɛ reba me nkyɛn
Ɔsoro nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ no
Abɔfoɔ hyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa
Bom to nkwagyeɛ dwom dɛɛdɛ.

10.chorus:
O Buelah man, ɔman fɛɛfɛɛ
Berɛ a mɛgyina wo mmepɔ so
Mahwɛ ɛpo no agya hɔ
Bea a woasiesie adan ama me
Mɛhunu asuogya a ɛhyerɛn hɔ
Me soro ne me fie afebɔɔ.

verses.text:
Monsuro ekuo ketewa
Agyenkwa no aka sɛ
Agya no de ahennie no bɛma mo
Mommfa fam ha bɔne
Nsɛe mo ntadeɛ
Me nnwan ho bɛyɛ fitaa sɛ sukyerɛma

Fitaa pa ara mɛhyerɛn akyɛn adekyeeɛ
Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo yɛ abura a ɛhoro bɔne
O ɔbɔneyɛfoɔ fa w’adesoa yi ma no
Na fa wo haw nyinaa kɔka ne kuo no ho.

Odwan a ɔyeraa wɔ bɔne bunu mu no
Dwanhwɛfoɔ no hunuu no de no baa fie
N’aseda nnwom gyegye mmepɔ no so sɛ
M’ayɔnkofoɔ, mahunu odwan a ɔyɛraeɛ no

Yesu yɛ wo dwanhwɛfoɔ, ne nsa yɛ ɔgyeɛ
Ɔrennyaa wo da, ɔyɛ onua ne adamfoɔ
Ɔbɛdɔ wo agye wo wiase a ɛnni awieeɛ no mu

Fitaa pa ara (Mepɛ mayɛ)
Fitaa pa ara (Mepɛ saa mayɛ Agyenkwa)

verses.text:
Ɛyɛ sɛ metwere Yesu

Na mehunu deɛ Nyame seɛ.

Ɛyɛ sɛ metwere Yesu

Mogya a ɛte me ho no m’

Ɛyɛ ampa sɛ metwere Yesu

Ɛyɛ sɛ metwere Yesu

Menim yie sɛ woka me ho

12.chorus:

Masɔ no mahwɛ mpɛn pii
Yesu, Yesu a ɔsom bo
Ma me adom mentwere wo pii.

verses.text:
Kristo yɛn gyefoɔ wo sɛ ayeyie
Anuonyam, nnidie ne tumi nso
Wofata yɛn kra ntontom nyinaa ara
Wofata yɛn wura, wofata pii.

Momma mo nne so ayeyie ne som mu
Ahotefoɔ nyinaa monkoto no
Soro abɔfoɔ nso nsom no nka sɛ
Wofata yɛn wura, wofata pii.

Yɛn wura ma yɛmfa nnwontoɔ mmra w’anim
Wo honhom, nyansa ne tum’ nhyɛ yɛn ma
Ma yɛmfa anuonyam ne nnidie mma wo
Wofata yɛn wura, wofata pii.

13.chorus:
Wofata ahonya, nhyira ne nnidie
Wofata nyansa, anuonyam ne tumi
Wofata soro ne asase so nnaaseɛ
Wofata yɛn wura, wofata pii.

verses.text:
Adwuma abu ‘dwuma wɔ hɔ ma obiara
Tie mmoa sufrɛ no gyegye baabiara
Yesu frɛ atwafoɔ, mɛkeka me ho
Deɛn na me wura hwehwɛ
Me nie, soma me.

Akra a wɔwɔ amaneɛ mu no resu pii
Na ‘koma a ɛnni ahome no si apinii
Ɛwɔ sɛ wɔnya me dɔ ne ayamhyehyeɛ
Mayɛ ahoboa me wura, me nie, soma me.

Akra a ɛkɔm de wɔn su hwehwɛ aduane
Wɔrepre apɛ nkwa  aboodoo no adi
So ɛkɔm nne wɔn berɛ a aduane abu yi?
Ma menni nokorɛ, me nie, soma me.

Akra bi rekyinkyini kɔ mmusuo mu

Ma menkɔse wɔn sɛ monnane, nnwane
Me wura mɛgye wɔn nkwa, me nie, soma me.

14.chorus:
Mewɔ ha, soma me
Me wura mewɔ ha soma me
Mayɛ ahoboa, me wura soma me.

verses.text:
Sɛ w’ahotefoɔ de anigyeɛ

Sɛ wɔrebɛhyia adidi
De akae wo wuo nwanwa no a
Woka wɔn ho de anigyeɛ a
Ɛsen fam ha deɛ hyira wɔn.

Yɛde ‘dɔ koma ne ayeyie nnwom
Apue w’asɔre fie ha seesei
Yɛn ani gye sɛ yɛn nkwa nna nyinaa
Wo nti yɛkɔ ahummɔborɔ adwa anim
Na yɛn Agya anim hɔ
Yɛnya anigyeɛ wɔ akoma ne adwene mu.

Nyame adwammaa ɔdɔ adidie yi
Ayɔnkofa wɔ wo honam ne mogya m’
Twam adidie a ɛkorɔn sɛɛ
Wɔdii aduane nwonwono no ntɛm so
Yɛn deɛ yɛnni yea biara nnɛ
Wo mogya ayi ne nyinaa afiri hɔ.

Yɛbubu aboodoo a ɛkasa kyerɛ yɛn
Aboodoo kronkron a
Wode ma sɛ ɛnyɛn yɛn kra
Na yɛnyɛ Agyenkwa wo deɛ ampa
Wo ne yɛn nkwa, ɔsoro aboodoo
Nkwa a ɛfiri Agya no bo m’.

Kuruwa a yɛhyira no! yɔnkofa dɛɛdɛ
Wɔ deɛ ɔde ne mogya horo yɛn ho no m’
Na wama yɛn afata n’anim,
Sɛ yɛtwam kɔ asuo n’akyi hɔ a
Yɛn wura yɛda wo ase dɔn fɛɛfɛ yi a
Ɛkyerɛ wo nkwagyeɛ tumi nyinaa.

Nisuo nni soro, awerɛhoɔ nni hɔ
Ɛhɔ bɛyɛ anuonyam man
Awerɛhoɔ mma hɔ, anigyeɛ nkutoo
Sɛ yɛkɔdɔm anigyeɛ kuo no.

Anuonyam retwɛn, ɛretwɛn nohoaa
Ɛhɔ na adeɛ rensa da
Yɛne yɛn Agyenkwa bɛtena daa daa
Na nisuo mmu aba mu bio.

Da bi anɔpa yɛbɛgyae adwendwene
Deɛ yɛahunu ɔbra yi mu ho
Yɛbɛhunu biribiara, yɛadɔ ahotefoɔ
Adeɛ nyinaa bɛyɛ foforɔ

Nisuo nni soro ahemman m’

verses.text:
‘hɔhoɔ bi gyina wo pono ano, ma no mmra m’

21.twi_title: KA YESU HO ASƐM KYERƐ ME

verses.text:
Ka Yesu ho asɛm kyerɛ me
Twerɛ ne nyinaa m’akoma m’
Asɛm a ɛsom bo sei yi
Ɛyɛ dɛ kyɛn nsɛm nyinaa
Ka sɛdeɛ abɔfoɔ de nne korɔ
Too nnwom de hyiaa n’awoɔ
Anuonyam nka soro soro Nyame
